lines.text: The five daughters of Zelophehad stood before Moses, Eleazar the priest, the leaders, and the whole congregation at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
They said their father died in the wilderness because of his own sin, and he had no sons.
They asked to be given property among their father's brothers so his name would not disappear from his clan.
Moses brought their case before the LORD, who said they spoke correctly and told him to give them their father's inheritance.
The LORD's rule said a man's inheritance goes to his daughter, then his brothers, then his father's brothers, then his nearest clan relative.
